findings.title: Retained records keep a stale theme when reconcile receives a different theme
findings.message: The theme passed to reconcile is used to validate and to mount new records. Retained records keep their original `r.theme` and are never updated, and `ThemeExtension.SetTheme` is called only in mountShallow. If reconcile is called with a theme different from the one a retained record was mounted with, the tree ends up with mixed themes. Validation is also done against a theme that the retained nodes do not actually use for styling.
findings.suggestion: When reusing a record, update `r.theme` for the whole retained subtree to the active theme. Call `SetTheme` on extensions again if it changed, and request an Update. Alternatively, make the theme a mandatory non-variadic parameter and document that it is immutable per root.
